verdict.rationale: a-Shell has programmatic surfaces: Apple Shortcuts actions and an optional built-in relay HTTPS server with POST /run. API versioning and deprecation policy are therefore a fair question for this product. The evidence states there is no API versioning or changelog, the relay endpoint is described only in README prose, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404, so nothing shows versioned APIs or a documented deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
